title: The African mission and of the propagation of the faith and of the millions of black and brown and yellow souls that had not received the baptism of water when their last hour came like a thief in the night
html_source:
“Like a thief in the night” appears in the Bible in 1 Thessalonians 5.

Here, Father Conmee thinks about those who have not heard of the Christian belief, and is worried by the idea that God may not take these people into account. This portrays his motivation to spread the church teachings. It also presents an anxiety over not knowing when the expected will occur: a supernatural occurrence that is to be expected at all times, and only those who are part of the church will be part of this divine manifestation.
